name: inbox.reply
description: The reply to a message, kept with who sent it; it waits as queued, since no platform sender exists yet, and the message leaves the queue. A message already answered or cleared is refused, so two replies at once keep the first.
sql: update brandbase.inbox_messages m set reply_text = btrim(:text), reply_status = 'queued', replied_by = :actor, done_at = :now::timestamptz where m.id = :id and m.brand_id = :brand and m.done_at is null returning brandbase.camel(to_jsonb(m)) || jsonb_build_object('receivedAt', brandbase.iso(m.received_at), 'doneAt', brandbase.iso(m.done_at)) as result
